neighbours.label: past-tense verb or auxiliary pointing back at something just experienced: 'That was', 'hope you found', 'hope you were', 'Did you'; the present-tense versions stay quieter
fire: Honestly, that was the best meal of my trip.
We hope you liked this guide to lawn care.
Thanks for visiting, and I hope you were able to find what you needed.
Did you watch the match on Sunday?
I hope you had a wonderful holiday with your family.
Wow, that was a long drive home.
Did your mother call you about the party?
We hope you enjoyed this short tour of the museum.

notes: The + pole of this neuron fires on the present-tense counterparts (have, has, is, 's), and its output direction suppresses ' last', ' yesterday', ' was', ' did', so tense looks like the distinction the neuron draws.
